preregistered_thresholds.directional_against_route: gap_lib(m,2) decreases monotonically from m=4 to the largest computed m by a total factor >= 3 AND gap_lib(m_max,2) < 0.1
preregistered_thresholds.constructive_lead: some single frame family (root, vertex, or spherical) keeps its degree-2 gap >= 0.2 for all computed m
preregistered_thresholds.exact_certificate_escalation: only an exact rational witness (frame weights + PD certificate) proving Lambda_{m,2} >= c for all computed m, or an exact dual certificate proving Lambda_{m,2} <= eps_m with eps_m decreasing, is a prover-escalable candidate; neither is a status change
